cards.title: NCA Model Selection and Input Requirements
cards.claim: Phoenix NCA requires specific model IDs based on matrix and dose type (e.g., 200 for extravascular plasma, 201 for IV bolus). Plasma models require 'time of last dose' and 'Tau' for steady-state. Urine models assume single-dose data and require interval start/end times.
limitations: Vss is not computed for extravascular dosing
Urine models do not depend on dose type for final parameters

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
